metadata.description: Live-captured via bin/mock-capture against <internal-env>/26.2.0.0, org group 138883 (sdktest), the recapture epic's Group A retry. Resolves AppsV2Service.UpdateAssignmentRuleAsync -- the endpoint the deprecated PUT /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationId}/assignments call's X-API-Warning header (captured in a sibling session) pointed at as its replacement. HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED: called against the same real internal iOS app used for the sibling GET/POST assignment-rules captures, using the app's own UUID directly as {applicationUuid} -- no separate applicationUuid namespace exists for this route. Body {} (an empty rule: no assignments, no excluded_smart_groups) is accepted -- swagger's validation error #7 ('Smart groups should not be empty for assignments') only triggers when the assignments array itself is non-empty; an empty/absent assignments list is a legal no-op update. 202 Accepted, empty body, no anonymization needed. App deleted at session end; deletion confirmed via post-delete GET (401/errorCode 7000).
